witness_details.name: Sunita Yadav
witness_details.occupation: Domestic Help (Maid) at Meena Devi Sharma's house
witness_details.address: Jhuggi Cluster No. 4, Sector 22, Dwarka, New Delhi - 110075

witness_statement.statement_under_section: Section 161 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973
witness_statement.statement_text: My name is Sunita Yadav and I have been working as a maid at Meena Aunty's house for the past 4 years. I work there from 4 PM to 8:30 PM every day. Aunty was a very nice lady and treated me like family. I also know Sanjay Bhaiya - Sanjay Sharma - who is Aunty's brother-in-law (her late husband's younger brother). He used to visit the house sometimes. For the last 6-7 months, every time Sanjay Bhaiya visited, there used to be a quarrel between him and Aunty. I have personally heard Sanjay Bhaiya shout at Aunty demanding that she sell 'the Sonipat property' and give him money for his business. Aunty always said no and told him that the property belonged to her daughters and would go to them. Sanjay Bhaiya used to get very angry. Once in October, I heard him threatening Aunty that 'she will have to pay the price' for refusing. Aunty was scared of him. On 5th December 2024, I finished my work and left Aunty's house at 8:35 PM. When I was leaving, Aunty was watching TV in the living room. She was alone as Rekha Didi (her daughter) had left for office at 8:30 PM. On the morning of 6th December, when I heard the news from my neighbor, I was shocked and devastated. Aunty did not deserve this. I also want to tell the police that I have seen Sanjay Bhaiya visiting the house through the back entrance a few times even when Aunty had told him not to come. He knew the house layout very well. Aunty had shown me that her late husband had given a set of keys to Sanjay Bhaiya long ago which he never returned. I am saying whatever I know is true and I will cooperate with police in this case.

identification_of_accused.identification_details: Sanjay Sharma - known for 4 years, has visited the house many times, well acquainted
